info.name: SEC EDGAR Data Company Concept Frames API
Get cross-company data for a concept in a period

params.name: taxonomy
params.description: XBRL taxonomy. One of us-gaap, ifrs-full, dei, or srt.

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit of measure. Common values: USD, shares, pure, USD-per-shares.

params.name: period
params.description: Reporting period. Annual: CY2023. Quarterly duration: CY2023Q1. Quarterly instantaneous: CY2023Q1I.

items.docs: Returns data for a given XBRL concept across all companies that reported it for a specific period. This enables cross-company comparisons for any financial metric. Periods can be annual (CY2023), quarterly (CY2023Q1), or instantaneous (CY2023Q1I for point-in-time balance sheet concepts). The response includes each company's CIK, entity name, accession number, location reference, and reported value.
